topic: evidence boundaries in early-stage security projects - stating plainly what is verified today versus aspirational, so downstream business documents (offer, pilot, funding, case study) inherit honest claims

subtopics.scope: How to inventory and verify the technical assets and public artifacts (public repo, license file, CI lanes, published images, provenance and SBOM attestations, staged upstream forks) that ground engineering-progress claims.
seed_queries: open source project verified public artifacts CI pipeline evidence inventory
SLSA provenance SBOM attestation container image public build evidence

subtopics.scope: Separating evidence of engineering progress (code, CI, docs) from evidence of product-market fit (customers, pilots, committed pricing), and why the two are routinely conflated in early-stage claims.
seed_queries: engineering progress versus product market fit evidence early stage startup
distinguishing technical milestones from commercial validation startup claims

subtopics.scope: Maintaining a live, numbered blocker list as the single source of truth for current project status, with dated snapshot documents deferring to it rather than restating status.
seed_queries: blocker tracking document single source of truth software project status
software project readiness blockers open issue list living document

subtopics.scope: Why CI and VM-lane evidence cannot back hardware or physical-device claims (token enumeration, physical key validation), and the ladder between simulated and real-hardware proof.
seed_queries: hardware in the loop CI testing FIDO2 YubiKey validation
software emulation versus real hardware verification security product claims

subtopics.scope: Enumerating claims that must stay off-limits until specific named evidence closes (production-ready, platform support, ROI figures, sealed boot), and enforcing that list across documents.
seed_queries: startup marketing claims governance evidence based claims policy
overclaiming security startup marketing risk compliance

subtopics.scope: Non-affiliation and trademark boundaries as part of the honest-claims surface: explicit disclaimers that a project is not affiliated with or endorsed by a trademark holder, independent of blocker status.
seed_queries: trademark non-affiliation disclaimer open source project best practices
nominative fair use trademark open source project naming

subtopics.scope: Mapping evidence state to gate levels (provisional entry through general availability) and which market claims unlock at which gate.
seed_queries: product readiness gates go to market stages software security
launch readiness criteria gating public claims software releases

subtopics.scope: The commercial validation gap (zero customer discovery interviews, design partners, paid pilots, signed statements of work) and what evidence standards close it.
seed_queries: customer discovery interviews evidence startup validation methods
paid pilot design partner statement of work early customer evidence

subtopics.scope: Writing a reusable external evidence-boundary summary, dating it, and the supersession rule (later evidence supersedes snapshot lines without back-editing), plus how downstream business docs cite the canonical boundary.
seed_queries: technical documentation dated snapshot versus living document status claims
evidence boundary statement reusable boilerplate honest claims
